title: ID0423864-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PD 312571675/22] Technical Error
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
I'm contacting you because the charger is faulty. Here's the error code
that our monitoring system is reporting: "VendorErrorCode":
"SPD_FA1_or_Fuse_FC1_AC-Income". I'm also posting a photo of the error flags.
I'll visit you tomorrow to see if the fuses are OK or if the XD31-2 cable is incorrectly connected.
Does this type of error occur repeatedly?
Thank you in advance for your feedback.
